newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Deutsche Australia says Barnes to retire.
newsitem.headline: Deutsche Australia says Barnes to retire.

text.p: Deutsche Morgan Grenfell Australia chief executive John Barnes said he would retire at the end of 1997.
The investment bank, which was formerly known as Bain and Co and ranks as one of the nation's largest brokers, said Sue Griffin would become chief operating officer.
Griffin is now group services director.
Barnes held the chief executive's job for 10 years and had been with the company for 17 years.
He recently oversaw the $240 million takeover and integration of the Axiom funds management business from the New South Wales state government.
Klaus Albrecht would continue as chief executive and country head of the Deutsche Bank group in Australia and New Zealand while Maurice Newman would continue as chairman of Deutsche Morgan Grenfell.
Albrecht said in a statement that the group's year-to-date profit was well ahead of budget. The Australian operations earned A$85 million before tax last year, a rise of 21 percent.
